summary: 10.0.34.02 Enterprise Release - Full Parity & Defect Correction (22-Item Suite)
highlights: 1. Registration Flow: Fixed TOTP QR code modal z-index above auth overlay, auto-launching setup modal upon email verification, and unblocking orphaned MFA registrations in Admin Approvals
2. Omni-Search & Workspace Navigation: Removed redundant environment & version tags to widen search bar to 580px, dynamic user pill, and removed tab hints strip
3. Standardized .btn-purple Action Menus: Unifying Sales, Purchases, Bank Entry, Expense Entry, Bank Reconciliation, Credit/Debit Notes, and Reminder Center under floating ::: Actions dropdown
4. Bank & Expense Registers: Desktop 3-mode strip parity (Bank, Expense, Reconciliation), 6-month default date filters, and custom voucher type & category filters
5. Sales & Purchase Returns: Integrated in-place return creation modal from registers, side drawer inspection, and 6-month default date filters
6. User Access & Security: Dual-query pending approvals supporting both PENDING_ADMIN_APPROVAL and MFA_ENROLLMENT_PENDING with dynamic rowVersion concurrency
